name: numt_trap
headline_stat: fraction of mito-origin reads correctly placed on mito contig vs. captured by NUMTs, stratified by NUMT identity

construction.description: Take a nuclear scaffold slice (chr1 slice) and embed 50-200 NUMT fragments copied from the human mitochondrial reference (rCRS NC_012920.1), each degraded to a target identity (60-99%), at random positions. Keep the true mito chromosome in the reference. Spike a high-coverage (~1000x) mito read set into a normal-coverage nuclear background.

simulation.command: dwgsim -1 150 -2 150 -C 30 -z {rng_seed} ../reference/reference.fasta nuclear_reads && dwgsim -1 150 -2 150 -C 1000 -z {rng_seed} ../reference/mito.fasta mito_reads && cat nuclear_reads.bwa.read1.fastq.gz mito_reads.bwa.read1.fastq.gz > reads_1.fastq.gz && cat nuclear_reads.bwa.read2.fastq.gz mito_reads.bwa.read2.fastq.gz > reads_2.fastq.gz
simulation.notes: Nuclear reads at 30x; mito reads at 1000x spiked in. The read name encodes true origin (nuclear vs. mito) for evaluation.

sweep.notes: NUMTs are embedded across the full identity range. Bin mito-origin reads by the identity of the NUMT they were captured by and report misrouting rate per bin.

truth.eval_notes: Mito-origin read classified as misrouted if it maps to a nuclear NUMT position (check against numt_truth.bed) rather than the mito contig. False mito-like coverage on nuclear NUMTs at each identity bin is the headline stat.
